name: Bonegrip's Note
summary: In Ironforge, Gerrig Bonegrip writes down the three relics he needs. The note lets him keep their names from unwelcome ears.

sections.title: Written Names
sections.body: Gerrig Bonegrip asks you to bring three items of power to him in Ironforge. He will not speak their names aloud, for ears may be listening. Instead, he writes them on Bonegrip's Note and gives it to you.

faq.answer: Bonegrip's Note is a written list of three items of power Gerrig Bonegrip needs.
Gerrig Bonegrip wrote the note so he would not have to speak the relics' names aloud.
Gerrig needs the Star of Xil'yeh, the Hand of Dagun, and the Legacy Heart.

faq.q: Why are the names written down?
faq.answer: Gerrig says ears may be listening, so he writes down the relics' names instead of speaking them.

angles.text: As an Alliance traveler, you can gather the relics on Gerrig's note and bring them to him in Ironforge.

attribution: The Star, the Hand and the Heart (Alliance)
